book.name: 1Tasolonqe Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Tasolonqe Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Phawuloosappe, Silwaanoosappenne Ximtoosappe; Xoossaa Aawassinne Godaa Yesus Kirstoosayta gidida Tasolonqen diza ammaniza asaas nu Aawaa Xoossaafenne Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa kiyateththinne saroteththi inttes gido.
Tasolonqen Ammaniza Asaa Ammano Gishshas Shiiqida Galata
Nu inttena nu woosan qoppishe ubba wode Xoossaa intte gishshas galatoos.

Ammanoninne mino siiqoteththan intte ooththida ooso gishshas Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa bolla diza intte mino hidotan beettida intte minoteththaa gishshas nu Godaa Xoossaa, nu Aawaa sinththan ubba gallas intte gishshas qoppoos.
Xoossan dosettida nu ishatoo! Izi inttena dooridayssa nu eroos.
Gaasoykka Mishiraachcho qaalay intteko yiday wolqqara Xillo Ayananinne lo7eththi shaakki eriin attiin coo qaala xallan gidenna; qasseka nu intte gishshas giidi waani de7idaakko intte ereeta.
Ha7i intte nunanne Godaa misatideta; intte bolla ay metoy gakkidaa gidikkoka Xillo Ayana ufayssan qaalaa intte ekkideta.
Hessafe dendidayssan intte Maqidooniyaninne Akayan ammaniza asa ubbaas lo7o leemisota gidideta.
Godaa qaalay inttefe kezidi Maqidooniyaninne Akayan siyeteth xalla gidontta inttes Xoossa bolla diza ammanoy ubbason erettides; hessa gishshas nu inttes yootanaas aykkoka koshshenna.
Intte nuna wostti mokki ekkidaakkonne de7on diza tumu Xoossaas ooththanaas intte eeqatappe Xoossaako waani simmidaakko asay intte gishshas haasayees.
Qasseka Xoossi hayqoppe denththidayssa buro yaana hanqofe nuna ashshana Saloppe yaana Xoossa Naa Yesusa yuussaa intte wostti naagizaakko asay haasayees.
